sources.relevant_excerpt: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia) official homepage. The visa services are handled through a separate dedicated official platform linked in the 'Related Sites' footer section: https://ksavisa.sa . Visa-related eServices listed on the MOFA site are 'Family Visit Request', 'Office Authorization on work visa', and 'Work Visa Request for Organizations and Diplomatic Missions'. No tourist/eVisa eligible-country list, disposition detail, or fee schedule is exposed on this page; it delegates to the ksavisa.sa platform. (Page fetched and loaded; content summarized by fetch tool, no full tourist-visa policy text present.)

منصة التأشيرات (the Visa Platform) — official Saudi government visa application portal landing page. Contains login sections for individuals and government entities and an application-status inquiry form, and references the new 'KSA VISA' platform. A subpage notice reads: 'يجب التأكد من توفر بيانات جوازات السفر للمطلوبين للزيارة قبل البدء بتقديم الطلب' (passport data for the intended visitors must be verified before submitting an application). The landing page does not enumerate tourist eligible countries or fees.

sources.search_query: saudiembassy.sa tourist visit visa tourism requirements
sources.relevant_excerpt: Official unified embassy portal of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Lists a directory of 108 embassies and 20 consulates across 109 countries, with navigation for services, news, media and embassy information, and footer links to related government resources (including mofa.gov.sa). The legacy embassies.mofa.gov.sa embassy/consular visa pages now 302-redirect to this saudiembassy.sa portal. The portal landing page does not itself expose the tourist-visa eligible-country groups or fee schedule as machine-readable text (single-page-application content not returned to the fetch tool).
